string.text: Show or hide the HUD minimap with a keybind. Toggle flips it; Hold shows it only while the key is down. No key bound by default. Disable Minimap Toggle (RavenAscendant). To keep the HUD up while the item wheel is open, turn off Quick Action Wheel → Controls → Hide HUD.
Toggle flips the minimap; Hold shows it while held. Optional modifier below can reduce conflicts.
Toggle: flip on press. Hold: show only while the key is held (starts hidden in Hold).
